chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Leaving the Sunset for the show Weather Clear, Track Fast
summary: Nazarro's friend lures them back from Chicago to New York for Joe Lowry Jr.'s racetrack-boardinghouse show in which they play stable-boy entertainers.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: During my time in Chicago, after we had left the Balaban & Katz circuit from going to be enjoined from going on the stage at the theater there, we decided to make an agreement to pay off the lawyer for not serving the summons and leave Chicago and go to Cleveland, which we did. So while we were in Cleveland we decide that we'll get a job there in Cleveland which was because of Nazarro sending a friend of his to the cafe in Chicago where we were engaged in the Sunset Cafe to talk us into coming back to New York to do a show with Joe Lowry, Jr. (phonetic spelling) called "Weather Clear, Track Fast." So we finally decided we would go back to New York and do this show since we weren't going to be involved for no entanglements.

The show where Joe Lowry was a jockey -- you know Joe Lowry, Jr., was a jockey on a racetrack and he'd ride the horses and we would entertain in this sort of a boarding house. But the idea was the girls would entertain, too. They did singing, no dancing, just singers. And it was a lovely show and the show was a success.
What was the story in the show?
"Weather Clear, Track Fast," racetrack, boarding house. To give you the theme of the show is one of the hardest things I could think of. I never took much attention to it. However --
Did you play a major role in it?
The only role we do is entertain the boys in the boarding house, the fellas that come in to the boarding house. We'd entertain there, have a little show. That's
all we did there. It was just like a relief thing, like put on an act for colored intermission time, same difference.
However, the show was a success.
So this show you played a minor role in.
Yeah, just stable boys entertaining in the guest house duly timed for the different jockeys comeing in, you know. Which was very good,very nice and the show was a success.
